Q5227.reason: UCC 2-328: once a without-reserve auctioneer calls for bids and a bid is made, the goods cannot be withdrawn, so the $100 bidder can sue.

Q5234.reason: Generic plywood is still obtainable elsewhere; loss of the mill’s own reserve does not excuse performance under impossibility or UCC 2-615, and frustration of purpose is the wrong doctrine.

Q5238.reason: Adenylate energy charge is ([ATP]+0.5[ADP])/([ATP]+[ADP]+[AMP]), i.e. how fully the adenine nucleotide pool is phosphorylated.
